name: Runemaster audit: Unbound shortens an incoming Curse-dispel debuff's duration by 20% (#3654)
contract: Unbound 806718 effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_AURA_DURATION_BY_DISPEL (245), EffectMiscValue 2 (DISPEL_CURSE), EffectBasePoints -21 + DieSides 1 = -20%; effect 1 is the same aura for EffectMiscValue 1 (DISPEL_MAGIC), also -20%. Unit.cpp reads GetTotalAuraModifierByMiscValue(SPELL_AURA_MOD_AURA_DURATION_BY_DISPEL, spellProto->Dispel) for incoming harmful auras. Curse of Weakness (702) has Dispel 2 (DISPEL_CURSE) and a 120000ms base duration (SpellDuration 4) - long enough to observe a clean 20% cut with no CoA script needed. Verification note: WorldSession::HandleCancelAuraOpcode (SpellHandler.cpp:605) refuses to remove a non-positive aura ('don't allow remove non positive spells') - Curse of Weakness is harmful, so the client-style cancel_aura action silently no-ops on it. This uses set_aura with stacks 0 (Unit::RemoveAurasDueToSpell, no positivity check) to clear the curse between the two casts instead.

steps.label: Clear the curse (cancel_aura refuses non-positive auras)
Curse of Weakness duration is cut ~20% (0.75-0.85)
